Motto:- let's be a voice of voiceless

Arunachal dog and cat rescue is self run rescue with one goal- to help street dog and cat and be heard. 

The video here are short documentary videos of our rescue. 

Every donation, no matter how small, makes our life-saving rescues possible. 
Thank you for joining our rescue team. 

Please share our videos to support street animals rescue. 
Thank you🙏
For donation
U can gpay to 7085827646
Also UPI ID tarunjamoh@oksbi
